# FxIconButton (component)

`import { FxIconButton } from '@fixtures/multi-entry/button';`

Selector: `fx-icon-button`

> ⚠️ Deprecated: Use FxButton with an icon and `aria-label`.

> ⚠️ For new code, use instead: `fx-button` with an `aria-label`

Replaces: mat-icon-button

Button that only shows an icon.

## Inputs
- `[icon]: string` **required** — Name of the icon.

## Content projection (ng-content)
- `default`
